note: Jean-Marie Auwers: Tobie 2,12–18 (Vulgate) et la tradition latine d’interprétation du livre de Tobie. In: Institutum Patristicum Augustinianum (ed.): _L’esegesi dei Padri latini_. Rome (770 pp., 2 vols. with one pagination), vol. 1, pp. 77–82.

_haedum caprarum_ (…) _detulisset domi_ (Weber/Gryson, Clementina) – she brought the young kid home. While this is the natural translation, the Latin expression sounds odd, because literally, it means “she brought the kid at home.” Instead of _domi_ (at home) one would expect _domum._ The Nova Vulgata translates differently, without using _domi_ or _domum_ (Tobit 2:13 NVg).
